description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the FreeType cache subsystem, including cache manager, face ID, font, and glyph cache types, as well as functions for creating, resetting, and querying caches related to font faces, sizes, and glyphs.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_New
methods.description: Creates a new cache manager for font faces, sizes, and glyphs.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_Reset
methods.description: Empties a cache manager, releasing all cached face and size objects.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_Done
methods.description: Destroys a cache manager after clearing its cache.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_LookupFace
methods.description: Retrieves the FT_Face object associated with a face ID from the cache manager.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_LookupSize
methods.description: Retrieves the FT_Size object for a given scaler from the cache manager.

methods.name: FTC_Node_Unref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a cache node, allowing it to be flushed if count reaches zero.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_RemoveFaceID
methods.description: Removes all cache nodes associated with a specific face ID.

methods.name: FTC_CMapCache_New
methods.description: Creates a new character map cache.

methods.name: FTC_CMapCache_Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a glyph index for a character code in a charmap cache.

methods.name: FTC_ImageCache_New
methods.description: Creates a new glyph image cache.

methods.name: FTC_ImageCache_Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a glyph image from the cache.

methods.name: FTC_SBitCache_New
methods.description: Creates a new small bitmap cache.

methods.name: FTC_SBitCache_Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a small glyph bitmap in the cache.
